name: reel
title: Reel
description: A fixed centered card where images stack on the z-axis and each blooms open over the last. Five CSS-drawn placeholder screens stand in for your shots: a host swaps its own images in by replacing the contents of each .rl-shot with an img (object-fit cover).
useWhen: Showing a sequence of screenshots or product shots that should bloom open one over the last in a fixed frame.
You want the reveal itself (the centre-out mask) to be the only motion in the scene.
avoidWhen: You need a single framed photo rather than a sequence: use polaroid.
You want a scrolling wall of items rather than a stacked reveal: use infinite-marquee or perspective-marquee.
author: Remocn
